tools.name: search_platforms
tools.description: Find US jobs and gig apps a person can start without a job interview, filtered by category, background check, vehicle, payout speed, minimum age and more. Returns requirements, pay terms and a link to the full sourced listing on clockintoday.com.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.description: Full requirements and pay terms for one platform (e.g. DoorDash, Instacart, BioLife Plasma), with the source pages each value came from.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The platform categories with ids and counts, for use with search_platforms.

tools.name: dataset_summary
tools.description: Headline numbers across all tracked platforms: how many skip background checks, pay within a day, need no vehicle, accept under-18s, plus license and citation.
